propositions: Add plan_review_phase (planning|execution) to compiled reducer state, updated only by winning process_status targets: in_progress→execution, open→planning, others preserve; losing fork events and force transitions follow the same rule.

Extend plan-review attestation manifests with review-phase and conditional priority-floor lines in fixed order after advisory; execution reviews require priority_floor≥0.80; planning reviews omit priority_floor.

Execution-phase plan reviews enforce a fixed 0.80 blocking threshold floor in Pass-3, while planning reviews use normal thresholds; both validate phase compatibility (planning accepts planning/legacy/execution, execution accepts planning/legacy or execution≥0.80).

Persist plan_review_result_v2 JSON with review_phase (lowercase string), priority_floor (number, execution only), and enforce compatibility during re-sign through recorded phase/floor vs. current compiled state.

Thread review_phase through Pass-3 entry by updating both plan_review_precheck_output and plan_review_decide_input schemas and YAML gate blocks, then floor threshold via execution_review parameter to pass3_over_findings closure.

Collect immutable PlanReviewGeneration before LLM/probe; retry at most 3 times on tracker HEAD instability; under global lock require clean HEAD and exact generation; sign and commit atomically or return unsigned on any terminal mismatch/timeout/dirty tracker.
